reviewLimits: This is an independent calibration of primary judgments after seeing their anonymous scores, not two wholly independent scorings.
URL uses valid v3 provenance; CLI uses corrected v4 canonical .task-build execution. Shared full-build/typecheck unavailability is not a defect.
Trusted execution logs and matching frozen hashes supply runtime evidence. No novel production behavior failure has been asserted and no new mutation pool introduced.
Filtered worker-checks may omit scratch probes; omissions alone do not establish fabricated verification.
Point differences are anchored judgments, not measured effect sizes; source ties are not broken by line counts or report verbosity.
consistencyConcerns: One concrete scoring inconsistency requires correction: URL artifact-029 contains only falsy 0n, so apply the same missing-truthy-regression deduction used for boolean/number categories elsewhere. All other reviewed primary deductions are supported by their saved evidence.
CLI partial test-coverage half-points and URL integer category deductions are task-specific calibration choices. Do not pool raw cross-task scores or treat small differences as measured effect sizes.

Passing the common hidden suite is distinct from satisfying the saved-regression gate. Artifact-026 has correct source but lacks the required saved CSV directory regression and must remain non-ranking.
chmod-based archived red/green runs remain valid on the recorded non-root host; their repeatability limits affect saved-test quality, not a fabricated-check or production-behavior gate.
No interfaces/helpers are mandated, no useful helper is banned, and no source score is based on verbosity or line count. The small 003/032 deductions concern redundant predicate state specifically.

Filtered worker-checks are not exhaustive. In 016 and 025 the combined test/checker command exits 1 from the heuristic checker after tests report all pass; that must not be misread as a failed saved test or false green claim.
